evals.prompt: Audit the ccsn-find-simplifications skill in this repo — is it still accurate against the current tree and AGENTS.md? Fix what's stale.
evals.expected_output: Locates the older-named skill, runs the path audit (all paths exist as of 2026-09-16 realignment), doctrine diff, churn sweep, and a bounded live survey; reports clean or a small changed PR; never edits product code.
expectations: The pass located .agents/skills/ccsn-find-simplifications/SKILL.md as the target despite the older naming and did not create a new skill
A path audit ran over every backticked repo path in the skill and its results are reported
The report states exactly one outcome word: clean, changed, or blocked, with justification
Edits, if any, are confined to .agents/skills/ccsn-find-simplifications/ (no changes to src/, tests/, docs/, AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md, SECURITY.md)
A bounded live survey of one named domain ran using the skill's own corpus rules, with at least two candidates proven or rejected with evidence
Simplification candidates found during the pass are reported to the user but not committed or implemented
If the outcome is changed, the resulting SKILL.md passes check-skill-paths.sh with zero MISSING and the commit message names what rotted and why

evals.prompt: Run the maintenance pass on the dsh-find-simplifications skill: check it still matches the repo and ship corrections if needed.
evals.expected_output: Detects that examples/ was retired (commit 4125514a08, 2026-08-24) and that packages are nested (packages/<group>/<pkg>/src, so packages/*/src matches nothing), fixes the corpus/domain claims in the skill only, and produces a changed outcome with a commit on a branch.
expectations: The pass detects that the top-level examples/ tree no longer exists (retired 2026-08-24) and removes or corrects every claim in the skill that depends on it (production corpus, survey domains)
The pass detects that packages are nested (packages/<group>/<pkg>/src) so packages/*/src matches nothing, and corrects the production corpus rule to the real layout
The outcome is changed, with a commit on a local branch confined to .agents/skills/dsh-find-simplifications/
No edits outside the skill directory: no changes to packages/, docs/, AGENTS.md, or .agents/notes/
After the fix, check-skill-paths.sh reports no MISSING path except non-path spans such as the event prefix agent/*, and every remaining false positive is named in the report
A bounded live survey of one named domain ran with at least two candidates proven or rejected with evidence, and candidates are reported, not committed
The commit message or PR body names what rotted and why, in the repo's commit style
